description: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating classification accuracy results (in percent) for an ablation-style set of model variants across two datasets, with the left half labeled “PHEME” and the right half labeled “PolitiFact,” separated by a vertical dashed divider. The horizontal axis contains the category labels (rotated) in the same order for both datasets: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks from 75.0 up to 95.0 at regular 2.5-point intervals. In the PHEME group, six solid bars are shown with numeric annotations above each bar: “Ours” (dark maroon) at 89.84, “w/o comments” (orange) at 86.82, “w/o text” (pale yellow) at 80.10, “w/o select” (very light blue/gray) at 88.80, “w/o emotion” (light blue) at 87.34, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.17. In the PolitiFact group, the same six colored bars appear with annotated values: “Ours” (dark maroon) at 90.57, “w/o comments” (orange) at 85.85, “w/o text” (pale yellow) at 83.02, “w/o select” (very light blue/gray) at 89.62, “w/o emotion” (light blue) at 84.91, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.74. The bars are not shown as stacked; they are arranged as separate bars within each dataset section, and there is no legend beyond the repeated category labels and consistent color coding; no bars appear specially outlined or otherwise emphasized beyond the value annotations.
